description: Dataset underlying the publication: Scale-dependent forestation–hydropower trade-offs under climate change is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Awad Mohammed Ali, Anne Hoek van Dijke. This dataset consists of the outcomes of our investigation on the direct and indirect impact of potential forest cover change on water availability and gross hydropower potential under historical and future climate conditions. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: Excel. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
